author: anistark
title: Sakura Bus Stand
description: You sit at a bus stand in Night City under a cherry tree in full bloom. Petals drift down, slowly, while the street gets on with its night in front of you. No two nights go the same way.
ogAlt: Sakura Bus Stand: the view from a bench at a night bus stop in a hard-edged neon anime style, across a wet road and up a magenta side street, with people walking past as cherry petals drift down
canvasLabel: Animated view from a bench at a night bus stop in a hard-edged neon anime style, with a cherry tree just out of sight overhead: petals drift down while people, vehicles, cats and dogs pass on the wet street in front
share: A bench under a cherry tree in Night City, and petals that never stop falling. Mine began at {seed}.

card: The view from a bench in Night City, under a cherry tree in full bloom. Petals drift down and settle while the street carries on in front of you: people, traffic, a cat that comes over to look at you, and once in a long while a fight.
